WebRTC RFC 8859 / RFC 9143 SDP BUNDLE: IDENTICAL/TRANSPORT Categories & bundle-tag Re-Homing
P973 IDENTICAL Parity & Tagged-Only TRANSPORT Attribute Gate · P974 Atomic bundle-tag Re-Homing & [32, 256]kbps SUM Bandwidth
❌ Legacy SDP BUNDLE Category & Re-Homing Bugs
1. IDENTICAL Mismatch & Non-Tagged TRANSPORT Conflict (RFC 8859)
• m=audio has setup:active while bundled m=application has actpass
• Non-tagged m= line in re-Offer carries conflicting ice-ufrag/pwd
• Triggers setRemoteDescription OperationError & call teardown
2. Disabling bundle-tag m= Line Without Transport Re-Homing
• Stops first m= line (port=0) in a=group:BUNDLE mid0 mid1 mid2
• Fails to migrate TRANSPORT attributes (ufrag/pwd/candidates) to mid1
• Destroys shared DTLS/ICE transport → kills mid1 & mid2 in 0ms!
Enterprise Production Impact (Without P973–P974)
• Renegotiation fails when closing initial track in BUNDLE group
• Split-brain DTLS setup / fingerprint across bundled media lines
Verdict: BLOCK (Mux Category Conflict / Orphaned bundle-tag Drop)
✅ Deterministic RFC 8859 / RFC 9143 BUNDLE Guards (P973–P974)
P973: RFC 8859 IDENTICAL Parity & Tagged-Only TRANSPORT Gate
• Enforce identical fingerprint/setup/rtcp-mux across BUNDLE group
• Restrict TRANSPORT attributes (ufrag/pwd/candidate) to bundle-tag
• Clamp bundled m= sections per BUNDLE group in [1, 8]
• identicalOrTransportCategoryBundleViolations == 0
• Gate: evaluateWebrtcSdpRfc8859BundleMuxCategoryIdentical...()
P974: Atomic bundle-tag Re-Homing & [32, 256]kbps SUM Bandwidth
• Promote surviving mid1 to new bundle-tag before setting mid0 port=0
• Atomically migrate TRANSPORT attributes to new bundle-tag m= line
• Clamp RFC 8859 SUM-category aggregate b=AS/TIAS in [32, 256] kbps
• unrehomedBundleTagDropsOrSumBandwidthOverflows == 0
• Gate: evaluateWebrtcRfc9143TaggedMlineDisablementRehoming...()
Verdict: PASS (100% Mux Parity · Zero-Drop Re-Homing · 932 Tests)
